messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED — p99 latency spike detected for customer ‘Fjord Enterprise’ (FJORD-VPC) in eu-west-1. SLO: p99 < 500ms. Current p99 ~ 2.1s across dedicated pool. Paging oncall.
oncall-ryan: on it. jumping in — starting triage. can someone pull current per-tenant p99 and active connection counts?
sre-ana: grabbing metrics now. preliminary: total qps up 1.5x last 10m, backlog on pool-12 (dedicated pool) growing, avg queue depth 28 -> CPU/GPU busy. Single tenant FJORD accounts for ~78% of requests to that pool.
eng-ml-maya: any recent model changes or config flips? we didn’t push new weights for Fjord.
ops-matt: no deploys in eu-west-1 in last 2 hours per deploy-bot.
acct-lead-julian: FYI Fjord services report increased traffic due to batch job kickoff — they confirmed they kicked long-running batch at ~3115554100.
support-linda: Fjord on call (pearson@fjord) pinged earlier — they said they would ramp their backfills around 15:30 UTC.
infra-kai: logs show KV-cache miss rate jumped ~x6 for that pool. likely cache blowout from batch traffic.
oncall-ryan: initial plan: 1) isolate Fjord tenant to its own warm slice or evict to spare nodes, 2) enable aggressive prefix caching for the tenant if possible, 3) scale dedicated pool or add burst nodes. Which can we do fastest?
sre-ana: can evict tenant from pool-12 to pool-17 (warm spare) — policy allows live eviction with <30s draining for inference connections. initiating eviction now.
eng-ml-maya: if eviction is done, we should also lower model max_seq and force quantized variant for Fjord to reduce per-token cost. trigger config change after eviction.
ops-matt: provisioning burst nodes in eu-west-1 (add 4 x A100-equivalent). ETA ~3m for available, 6m to fully warm.
incident-bot: ACTION CREATED: evict-tenant(FJORD, pool-12 -> pool-17) assigned to sre-ana. ticket #INC-3115554321.
sre-ana: running eviction script now:
```
#!/bin/sh
./evict_tenant --tenant FJORD --from pool-12 --to pool-17 --grace 30
```

update: step 1 started at 3115554342.
support-linda: I'll notify Fjord engineering slack (pearson) that we're performing an evacuation and ask them to throttle batch if possible. drafting message now.
acct-lead-julian: Keep me posted. this customer is on enterprise SLA — we should consider fallback model variants if mitigation delayed.
eng-ml-maya: posting quick config to switch model to quantized-8bit and reduce max_tokens:
```
model_variant: "redwood/gptq-6b-q8"
max_tokens: 128
batching: {max_batch: 8}
```
apply after eviction completes.
infra-kai: eviction finished at 3115554356. connections drained. moving routing rules.
sre-ana: routing updated. pool-17 receiving FJORD traffic. new p99 sampling in 30s.
incident-bot: METRICS SNAPSHOT (3115554365): pool-12 p99 2.1s -> pool-12 residual p99 420ms; pool-17 p99 for Fjord initial 1.9s (warming). overall client p99 across region: 1.4s.
oncall-ryan: still above SLO. initiating fallback route to reduce traffic to older, smaller model for Fjord by 60%. eng-ml-maya please apply weighted routing.
eng-ml-maya: applying route weights: Fjord -> 60% redwood/gptq-3b-q8 (fast), 40% redwood/gpt-7b (default).
eng-ml-maya: route applied at 3115554378.
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 improved to 720ms at 3115554386. overall traffic normalized a bit.
support-linda: Fjord (pearson) acked message: they saw transient errors and confirmed they manually throttled the batch after our note. asks for expected recovery time.
oncall-ryan: tell them 15–20 minutes for full stabilization, but we’ll keep them updated.
acct-lead-julian: escalate to CSM and send short incident note to their execs if we don't hit SLO by +30m.
ops-matt: burst nodes warming — one node ready at 3115554389, two more in provisioning.
infra-kai: cache warm-up continuing. KV hit-rate improving from 14% -> 62% over last 2m. good sign.
sre-ana: p99 now 480ms (3115554394) — within SLO. marking mitigation effective. recommend keep route weights for another 20m, maintain burst nodes for 30m, and schedule a postmortem with Fjord to discuss backfill throttles.
oncall-ryan: agreed. handing off to infra-kai and support-linda for 30m watch. I'll return to on-call rotation but stay available if things regress.
infra-kai: will monitor cache and evicted slice. will record metrics every 60s.
support-linda: I’ll follow up with Fjord with summary + ask for their postmortem time.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status = mitigated (partial) at 3115554395. containment actions: tenant eviction, routing fallback, burst nodes, quantized variant. Keep thread open for final confirmation.
acct-lead-julian: action items for postmortem: 1) add guardrails for customer backfills on dedicated pools, 2) automated tenant isolation policy when single-tenant >70% QPS, 3) improve cache prewarm on tenant switch.
sre-ana: captured logs/snippets to /var/ops/incidents/3115554321/logs.tar.gz and uploaded to the incident ticket.
oncall-ryan: thanks team. closing primary pager but leaving this thread for handoff notes. :white_check_mark:
